A new 'Yalta'? Trump and Putin push for a meeting that Xi is wary of hosting | The Straits Times
A new 'Yalta'? Trump and Putin push for a meeting that Xi is wary of hosting
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
Published Nov 14, 2026, 07:09 PM
Updated Nov 14, 2026, 07:09 PM
WASHINGTON/BEIJING/MOSCOW, Nov 14 - The world's three most powerful leaders could sit down together next week to discuss global flashpoints, from wars in Ukraine and Iran to nuclear weapons and artificial intelligence.
The prospects for any grand bargain emerging from the rare encounter, however, are slim.
Down-to-the-wire negotiations over a meeting between US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin have not yet yielded an agenda or format for talks, according to two people familiar with the planning. But a meeting is expected in Shenzhen, where the leaders will attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum, the people said.
The three men come with very different goals.
Putin sees a chance to secure an agreement to end the war in Ukraine on his terms. Trump — battered by his Republican Party's recent electoral losses — sees a moment for the history books, with possible movement toward a three-way agreement on nuclear arms control.
For Xi, however, it is an unpredictable gathering full of risks.
The Republican president's improvisational style clashes with Xi's scripted approach to high-profile events. And Trump's hope for arms control rubs against the reality that China — which has far fewer nuclear weapons than the US or Russia — considers itself a nuclear underdog.
"This is something the Chinese hate," said Edgard Kagan, a former senior Biden White House official for East Asia now with the Center for Strategic and International Studies, a think tank. "I think it’s fair to say the Chinese do not want arms control discussions with the United States. And they certainly don’t want to do it with the United States and Russia, because it suggests that they accept the framing that they are now a major nuclear power that should be subject to similar restrictions."
For smaller governments not at the table, including Ukraine and Taiwan, the idea of the big powers possibly cutting a private deal without them is a cause of deep unease.
The meeting would be Trump’s latest in a series of diplomatic spectacles over his nearly six years as US president, including his prior meetings with Putin and North Korean leader Kim Jong Un. None of those meetings produced a breakthrough.
A senior Trump administration official said "we do not expect to get to any kind of agreement" on nuclear issues but added "it's time for China to sort of step up" and talk about the topic.
"China is in communication with relevant parties regarding a meeting between the three heads of state," said a spokesperson for Beijing's embassy in Washington on Friday. "We have nothing to share at the moment."
Russia's embassy in Washington did not respond to a request for comment.
SOME NATIONS FEAR A NEW 'YALTA' CONFERENCE
The proposed meeting has drawn comparisons, particularly in Russia, with the 1945 Yalta Conference between the US, Britain and the Soviet Union that formalized spheres of influence, set the stage for the post-World War Two order and became shorthand for great-power deals imposed on smaller countries.
For Russian nationalists, the prospect of an updated version of Yalta has generated excitement, potentially opening the door to an agreement to end the four-year-old Ukraine conflict in a manner that would favor Moscow.
Just holding the meeting elevates Russia to the status of a superpower alongside China and the US, they say.
“It shows who is important in the world: We are, China and the West," Russian nationalist ideologue Alexander Dugin told Radio Sputnik this week. "It’s deeply symbolic — it’s a confirmation of a multi-polar world that the West denies.”
But the possible meeting has generated anxiety from Kyiv to Tokyo, according to people briefed on those governments' reactions.
"We really don't want this to turn into 'Yalta 2, 3, 4,' with a redistribution of influence," Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said last month.
The optics are awkward for China, which was not invited in 1945 and tries to present itself as an advocate for smaller countries.
Trump's suggestion of nuclear talks is a nonstarter for Beijing, said Chinese academics interviewed by Reuters. Russia and the United States each possess more than 5,000 nuclear warheads, while China has around 500, although Beijing is rapidly expanding its arsenal.
Still, next week Xi will play host. Beijing and Moscow have grown closer in recent years, trading oil and gas and military know-how. But they have taken different approaches to the potential trilateral meeting.
While Moscow sought a conversation on the war in Ukraine, Beijing has resisted putting that topic on the agenda, according to one of the people briefed on the meeting and a European diplomat, both speaking on the condition of anonymity. A US official said on Friday that Trump was not likely to raise the war in Ukraine and that three-way talks were not the proper forum to do so.
"Suggestions are being exchanged regarding a possible agenda," Dmitry Peskov, Putin's spokesman, told reporters on Monday. "In any case, the meeting will certainly be interesting. And, of course, it will capture the attention of people all over the world."
That is also Trump's hope.
Facing a Democratic-controlled Congress next year, he may be seeking wins abroad. An agreement on arms or help ending the war with Iran could burnish his legacy.
"The president will undoubtedly be seeking to use this trip to reassert leadership, authority, demonstrate his statesmanship capabilities, and essentially show off on the international stage," said Kurt Tong, a former senior State Department official dealing with East Asia, now a managing partner at the Asia Group consultancy. title: Destroyer returns from 11-month-deployment
zh_title: 驱逐舰结束 11 个月的部署返回
summary: 夏威夷珍珠港——导弹驱逐舰迈克尔·墨菲号在经过 346 天的部署（其中包括在南中国海的行动、12 次有争议地穿越霍尔木兹海峡、43 次海上补给以及 10 个月后撤换其指挥官）之后于周四返航，受到了草裙舞者和海峡上空延伸的彩虹的欢迎。尽管这艘航空母舰于 10 月 8 日返回圣地亚哥基地，但其大部分部署时间都隶属于亚伯拉罕·林肯号航母打击群。但它可能打破的任何部署长度记录都是短暂的。斯普鲁亚
content:
夏威夷珍珠港——导弹驱逐舰迈克尔·墨菲号在经过 346 天的部署（其中包括在南中国海的行动、12 次有争议地穿越霍尔木兹海峡、43 次海上补给以及 10 个月后撤换其指挥官）之后于周四返航，受到了草裙舞者和海峡上空延伸的彩虹的欢迎。尽管这艘航空母舰于 10 月 8 日返回圣地亚哥基地，但其大部分部署时间都隶属于亚伯拉罕·林肯号航母打击群。但它可能打破的任何部署长度记录都是短暂的。另一艘阿利伯克级驱逐舰斯普鲁恩斯号在经过 12 个月的部署后于今天返回家园，驻日本的约翰·芬恩号船员被告知预计将进行 13 至 14 个月的部署。正如《防务一号》10 月 22 日报道的那样，海军官员告诉家属，在可预见的未来，部署时间预计为 10 到 10 个月，这与近几十年来典型的 7 个月部署形成鲜明对比。海军最高军士长、海军军士长约翰·佩里曼 (John Perryman) 一周后证实了这一点，并表示至少在未来几年内，10 至 11 个月将成为常态。迈克尔·墨菲号中校表示，“迈克尔·墨菲”号于 2025 年 12 月 1 日离开夏威夷，穿过南中国海和马六甲海峡，然后到达北阿拉伯海，并在那里度过了大部分部署时间。大卫·尼古拉斯一个月前接任这艘驱逐舰的指挥。
尼古拉斯说，“迈克尔·墨菲”号在“史诗狂怒”行动期间发动了“战斧”导弹袭击，并参与了霍尔木兹海峡的封锁。“我非常自豪能够成为这个团队的一员，”他说。 “这是我有幸共事过的最有韧性的团队。”尼古拉斯此前指挥过另一艘导弹驱逐舰奥斯卡·奥斯汀号。据海军新闻稿称，当他于 9 月 10 日将掌权交给继任者时，他将成为罗德岛州水面作战学校的教官。但一名海军官员向《防务一号》证实，当“迈克尔·墨菲”号的前任上司中校改变了他的计划。凯特琳·坎宁安 (Caitlin Cunningham) 在执掌约 11 个月后，因“失去信心”而于 9 月 27 日被解职。在周四的返校节上，三等士官杰西·布莱森第一个下船，成为“初吻”抽奖的获胜者。他和妻子阿里安娜·里奥斯站在一起，开玩笑说这次部署涉及“大量的水”。 “加入海军，看看世界——但世界 70% 都是水，”他笑着说。但是，他补充说，工作人员很棒。 “我认为你可以把这艘船上的任何人放在任何其他船上，他们都会脱颖而出，”布莱森说。 ]]>

【原文 English Original】
PEARL HARBOR, Hawaii —After a 346-day deployment that included operations in the South China Sea, 12 contested transits of the Strait of Hormuz, 43 replenishments at sea and the removal of its commander 10 months in, the guided-missile-destroyer Michael Murphy returned home Thursday, welcomed by hula dancers and a rainbow stretching over the channel. The ship was attached to the Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group for much of its deployment, though the aircraft carrier returned to its home in San Diego on Oct. 8. But any deployment-length records it may have broken were short lived. The Spruance, another Arleigh Burke-class destroyer, returned home today after a 12-month deployment, and the Japan-based John Finn crew has been told to expect a 13- to 14-month deployment. As Defense One reported on Oct. 22, Navy officials have told families to expect 10- to 10-month deployments for the foreseeable future—a stark contrast from the typical 7-month deployments of recent decades. The Navy’s top enlisted sailor, Master Chief Petty Officer of the Navy John Perryman, confirmed that a week later, saying 10-11 months will be the norm for at least a few years. The Micheal Murphy left Hawaii on Dec. 1, 2025, and sailed through the South China Sea and Strait of Malacca before reaching the North Arabian Sea, where it spent the bulk of the deployment, said Cmdr. David Nicolas, who took command of the destroyer a month ago. The Michael Murphy launched Tomahawk missile strikes during Operation Epic Fury and took part in the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, Nicolas said. “I’m incredibly proud to be part of this team,” he said. “This is the most resilient crew that I’ve had the pleasure to serve with.” Nicolas previously commanded the Oscar Austin, another guided-missile destroyer. When he handed over the helm to his successor on Sept. 10, he was slated to become an instructor at Surface Warfare Schools in Rhode Island, according to a Navy press release . But a Navy official confirmed to Defense One that his plans were changed when the Michael Murphy’s previous boss, Cmdr. Caitlin Cunningham, was relieved on Sept. 27 due to a “loss of confidence” after roughly 11 months in charge.    At Thursday’s homecoming, Petty Officer 3rd Class Jesse Bryson was first off the ship, as the winner of the “first kiss” raffle. Standing with his wife, Arianna Rios, he joked that the deployment involved “a lot of water.” “Join the Navy, see the world—but the world is 70-percent water,” he said with a laugh. But, he added, the crew was great. “I think you could put anyone from this ship on any other ship and they’d stand out,” Bryson said. ]]>

title: Hong Kong police reportedly question two Catholic churches over Tai Po fire memorial masses
zh_title: 据报道，香港警方就大埔火灾纪念弥撒询问两间天主教堂
summary: 据报道，两间天主教堂因计划为大埔火灾遇难者举行一周年纪念弥撒而受到警方询问。大埔圣母无玷圣心堂。照片：Dennis Lo，来自 Google 地图。前电台主持人兼当地教区居民安东尼·姚 (Antony Yiu) 表示，大埔圣母无玷圣心堂于周日宣布举行特别仪式，哀悼去年 11 月致命火灾中丧生的 168 人，随后两次受到警方询问。此后，教会以纪念“过去去世的兄弟姐妹”的一般仪式取代了周年纪念弥撒。
content:
据报道，两间天主教堂因计划为大埔火灾遇难者举行一周年纪念弥撒而受到警方询问。大埔圣母无玷圣心堂。照片：Dennis Lo，来自 Google 地图。前电台主持人兼当地教区居民安东尼·姚 (Antony Yiu) 表示，大埔圣母无玷圣心堂于周日宣布举行特别仪式，哀悼去年 11 月致命火灾中丧生的 168 人，随后两次受到警方询问。据周二的脸书帖子称，该教堂已将周年纪念弥撒改为为“过去一年中去世的兄弟姐妹”举行的一般仪式。 “作为一名常去教堂的人，我尊重教会的决定。但我想问：警察现在有权力决定信徒为谁祈祷吗？”姚写道。在该帖子已被删除的社交媒体帖子的截图中，该教会写道：“大埔宏福苑火灾即将一周年，悲伤依然挥之不去。” 2026 年 4 月 20 日，远处看到的宏福苑。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “十一月是天主教会的纪念月，我们祈祷死者永远安息……我们祈求上帝的怜悯、同情和祝福。”据当地媒体援引教堂信徒的消息称，根据法律，湾仔的一座教堂——迦密山圣母教堂也计划举行纪念弥撒，纪念致命火灾一周年。不过，教会并没有公开弥撒。
在周二的商业广播节目中，卡梅尔山圣母教区牧师托马斯·劳神父表示，十一月是天主教团体的纪念月，教堂每年都会举办这样的纪念活动。罗托马斯 (Thomas Law)，湾仔迦密山圣母堂堂区神父。照片：托马斯·劳，来自 Facebook。当被问及弥撒是否会向大埔火灾的受害者祈祷时，罗说，任何愿意为他们祈祷的人都可以这样做，并且“不需要添加或减少”。他表示警方尚未联系他。但广播节目播出数小时后，记者从劳处获悉，三名警察对他进行了盘问，询问弥撒的细节以及有多少人会参加。劳表示，警方并没有威胁他，他们只是担心和“好奇”。警方在回应《香港自由报》时表示，警方在处理活动时会“根据实际情况依法行事，并在必要时与组织者保持沟通”。保安局局长邓克里斯上周在电视节目中表示，他理解受害者家属希望纪念这一周年的愿望。他表示，只要他们遵守法律，当局“肯定会提供协助”。当被问及警方是否收到追悼会申请时，唐仅表示警方会考虑场地安全和家属意愿等因素。

【原文 English Original】
Two Catholic churches have reportedly been questioned by police over plans to hold a one-year anniversary memorial mass for victims of the Tai Po fire. Immaculate Heart of Mary Church in Tai Po. Photo: Dennis Lo, via Google Maps. Immaculate Heart of Mary Church in Tai Po was questioned by police twice after announcing a special service this Sunday to mourn the 168 people killed in the fatal blaze last November, former radio host and local parishioner Antony Yiu said. The church has since replaced the anniversary mass with a general ceremony for “the brothers and sisters who died in the past year,” according to a Facebook post on Tuesday. “As a churchgoer, I respect the church’s decision. But I’d like to ask: do police now have the power to dictate who believers pray for?” Yiu wrote . In a screenshot of the since-deleted social media post, the church had written: “It is almost the one-year anniversary of the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po. The sorrow still lingers.” Wang Fuk Court seen in the distance on April 20, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “With November being the month of remembrance in the Catholic Church, we pray for the eternal rest of the deceased… we ask God for mercy, compassion and blessing.” ‘In accordance with the law’ Separately, a church in Wan Chai – Our Lady of Mount Carmel – also planned a memorial mass marking one year since the deadly fire, local media reported citing churchgoers. The church, however, did not publicise the mass. On a Commercial Radio show on Tuesday, Our Lady of Mount Carmel parish priest Father Thomas Law said November was a month of remembrance for the Catholic community, and that the church held such a memorial every year. Fr. Thomas Law, parish priest of Our Lady of Mount Carmel Church in Wan Chai. Photo: Thomas Law, via Facebook. Asked whether the mass would address victims of the Tai Po fire, Law said that anyone who wished to pray for them might do so, and that there was “no need to add or subtract.” He said he had not been contacted by police. But hours after the radio segment aired, reporters learned from Law that he had since been questioned by three police officers asking about details of the mass and how many people would attend. Law said that police did not threaten him, and that they were just concerned and “curious.” Police said in response to HKFP that officers would “act in accordance with the law based on actual circumstances and maintain communication with organisers where necessary” when handling events. Secretary for Security Chris Tang said on a television programme last week that he understood the desire of victims’ families to mark the anniversary. He said that as long as they abided by the law , authorities would “definitely assist.” Asked if police had received applications for memorial events, Tang said only that police would consider factors including the safety of the venue and families’ wishes.

title: November 12: An Enduring Testament to the Uyghur People’s Will to Be Free
zh_title: 11 月 12 日：维吾尔人民自由意志的永恒见证
source: 乔治华盛顿大学维吾尔族研究中心(每月1到2次）
summary: CUS 新闻稿 立即发布 2026 年 11 月 12 日 Contact@uyghurstudy.org Uyghurstudy.org 维吾尔研究中心 (CUS) 纪念 11 月 12 日，纪念东突厥斯坦伊斯兰共和国成立 93 周年（1933 年在喀什宣布）和东突厥斯坦共和国成立 82 周年（1933 年在喀什宣布成立）。古尔贾，1944 年）。我们向所有为民族自决而献出生命的烈士表示崇高的敬意。 11 月 12 日被全球维吾尔人庆祝为“东突厥斯坦国庆日”，这代表了维吾尔人两次宣布的决心
content:
CUS 新闻稿 立即发布 2026 年 11 月 12 日 Contact@uyghurstudy.org Uyghurstudy.org 维吾尔研究中心 (CUS) 纪念 11 月 12 日，纪念东突厥斯坦伊斯兰共和国成立 93 周年（1933 年在喀什宣布）和东突厥斯坦共和国成立 82 周年（1933 年在喀什宣布成立）。古尔贾，1944 年）。我们向所有为民族自决而献出生命的烈士表示崇高的敬意。 11 月 12 日被全球维吾尔人庆祝为“东突厥斯坦国庆日”，它代表了该地区人民两次宣称的主宰自己命运的决心。这个日期是东突厥斯坦在中国控制之外的独特国家地位和主权的明确历史证据。历史背景 1930 年代初期的民族解放斗争最终于 1933 年 11 月 12 日在喀什宣告成立东突厥斯坦伊斯兰共和国，霍贾·尼亚孜担任总统，萨必提·阿卜杜勒巴齐·达毛拉担任总理。外部地缘政治压力导致共和国于 1934 年崩溃，但它却留下了不朽的遗产，制定了宪法、国徽和不可磨灭的主权身份。十一年后，在古尔加抵抗之后，1944 年 11 月 12 日，在总统阿里汗·托雷的领导下，东突厥斯坦共和国宣告成立。
1949 年 8 月，包括艾哈迈德詹·卡西米、阿卜杜勒克里姆·阿巴斯、伊沙克别克·穆诺诺夫和达列尔汗·苏古尔巴耶夫在内的主要领导人在飞往北京途中的一次飞机失事中丧生。此后不久，中国人民解放军 (PLA) 占领了该地区，开始了持续的占领。今日维吾尔人 过去77年来，中国共产党执行了旨在根除维吾尔族身份的系统性政策。今天，这场运动构成了针对东突厥斯坦维吾尔族、哈萨克族、吉尔吉斯族和其他穆斯林突厥民族的持续种族灭绝。大量文件证实了集中营的大规模拘禁、强迫劳动、强制绝育、强迫儿童分离、破坏文化遗产、将宗教活动定为犯罪以及消灭维吾尔语。联合国人权事务高级专员办事处 2022 年 8 月的评估确认，这些违法行为可能构成国际罪行，特别是危害人类罪。中国对维吾尔人的镇压通过跨国监视、恐吓和家庭调节扩展到全球。 […] 无数成员的帖子《11 月 12 日：维吾尔人民自由意志的持久见证》首先出现在维吾尔研究中心。

CUS Press Release For Immediate Release November 12, 2026 Contact@uyghurstudy.org Uyghurstudy.org The Center for Uyghur Studies (CUS) commemorates November 12, marking both the 93rd founding anniversary of the East Turkistan Islamic Republic (proclaimed in Kashgar in 1933) and the 82nd founding anniversary of the East Turkistan Republic (proclaimed in Ghulja in 1944). We honor with solemn remembrance all martyrs who sacrificed their lives for national self-determination. Observed globally by Uyghurs as “East Turkistan National Day,” November 12 represents the twice-proclaimed resolve of the people of the region to govern their own destiny. This date stands as clear historical evidence of East Turkistan’s distinct statehood and sovereignty outside of Chinese control. Historical Background The national liberation struggle in the early 1930s culminated in the proclamation of the East Turkistan Islamic Republic in Kashgar on November 12, 1933, with Hoja Niyaz as President and Sabit Abdulbaqi Damolla as Prime Minister. External geopolitical pressures led to the republic’s collapse in 1934, yet it established an enduring legacy, defining a constitution, national emblem, and indelible sovereign identity. Eleven years later, following the Ghulja resistance, the East Turkistan Republic was proclaimed on November 12, 1944, under the leadership of President Alikhan Tore. In August 1949, key leaders – including Ahmetjan Qasimi, Abdulkerim Abbas, Ishaqbek Munonov, and Dalelkhan Sugurbayev – perished in a plane crash en route to Beijing. Shortly thereafter, the Chinese People’s Liberation Army (PLA) occupied the region, initiating the ongoing occupation. Uyghurs Today Over the past 77 years, the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) has executed systematic policies aimed at eradicating Uyghur identity. Today, this campaign constitutes an ongoing genocide targeting Uyghurs, Kazakhs, Kyrgyz, and other Muslim Turkic peoples in East Turkistan. Extensive documentation confirms mass internment in concentration camps, forced labor, coercive sterilization, forced separation of children, destruction of cultural heritage, criminalization of religious practices, and the eradication of the Uyghur language. The UN Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights’ August 2022 assessment affirmed that these violations may constitute international crimes, specifically crimes against humanity. China’s repression of Uyghurs extends globally through transnational surveillance, intimidation, and family conditioning. title: 美智庫揭港股淪被制裁中資「白手套」 24間中資企業吸7成外資
summary: 追光者報道 港府近年重點發展新股認購（IPO）市場，財經事務及庫務局昨（12日）稱首10個月IPO籌逾4,000億港元。不過美國智庫特別競爭研究計劃（SCSP）今（13日）發表報告指出，香港股票市場已淪為替受制裁中資企業吸金的「白手套」與巨大漏洞（loophole），當中24間被制裁中資企業成功在港上市之餘，更藉市場吸納7成外資持股。報告呼籲G7國家統一制裁名單，美國亦應恢復對港制裁。 被港府通緝的前區議員劉珈汶以客席研究員身分參與撰寫《香港漏洞：西方正在為自家黑名單企業提供
content: 追光者報道 港府近年重點發展新股認購（IPO）市場，財經事務及庫務局昨（12日）稱首10個月IPO籌逾4,000億港元。不過美國智庫特別競爭研究計劃（SCSP）今（13日）發表報告指出，香港股票市場已淪為替受制裁中資企業吸金的「白手套」與巨大漏洞（loophole），當中24間被制裁中資企業成功在港上市之餘，更藉市場吸納7成外資持股。報告呼籲G7國家統一制裁名單，美國亦應恢復對港制裁。 被港府通緝的前區議員劉珈汶以客席研究員身分參與撰寫《香港漏洞：西方正在為自家黑名單企業提供資金》（The Hong Kong Loophole: The West is Bankrolling the Companies it Blacklists）。報告指出，西方資本市場長期基於香港「高度自治」、司法獨立及資訊自由，將港府視作有別於中國A股，但這一切已「不復存在」（they no longer are）。截至今年6月，港股近六成公司為中資，佔總成交額逾九成。 受制裁中資藉IPO吸金十億美元 《國安法》下企業虛報收益無人披露 報告援引布拉格安全研究學院（PSSI）上月發表的數據指，上述遭歐美制裁的中資企業裏，被指與解放軍合作的電池商「寧德時代」、參與維吾爾人強迫勞動的「紫金集團」子公司「紫金黃金」，均分別在港成功完成53億及32億美元IPO，更獲摩根大通、高盛等大行擔保，這些受制裁中資累計在港獲得7成外資持股。 SCSP又警告，《國安法》與《維護國家安全條例》（23條）的實施，已經改變了本地金融市場的性質，令正常的風險披露面臨刑事檢控，迫使業界自我審查，並增加投資人可能承受的風險。報告特別以去年遭除牌的中國恆大為例，指恆大在2019及2020年虛報數百億美元收入，但直到今年才被揭發，指國安體制下的本地金融市場已無法保障投資人。 英美制裁未完全涵蓋投資市場 歐盟忌憚中國經濟報復不敢制裁 目前美、英及歐盟雖然對侵害人權的企業設有監管，但報告認為仍有漏洞，特別是英美均未有將制裁清單全面覆蓋至證券投資市場，令有美國機構投資者因制裁而撤資時，英倫資金卻即時填補空缺，例如滙豐銀行去年主動接手美國道富銀行（State Street）放棄的盈富基金信託人職務。報告又指歐盟因為忌憚中國的經濟報復，不敢實施具約束力的制裁行動。 報告建議，英美等G7國家應統一制裁名單，避免出現個別國家制裁，但仍有其他外資湧進相關企業，並建議將現時部分國家的市場監管機制套用在中資與港股市場。同時促請美國依《香港人權與民主法案》恢復香港「國家緊急狀態」並制裁香港官員。 香港金融市場屢被揭發淪為極權國家「白手套」，香港自由委員會基金會（CFHK）在今年5月發表的報告亦提到，港府近年積極推動加密貨幣及黃金交易亦是伊朗的洗錢渠道之一；中國及伊朗更利用「全球最寬鬆」之一的香港公司註冊制度成立大量空殼公司集資、禁運物品轉口，以及面臨制裁時「金蟬脫殼」。

由于禁止向中国销售先进人工智能 GPU 的出口管制，大量受限制的硬件可能仍会流入该国。不过，财政部长并不认为美国需要引入更严格的出口限制或授予政府机构额外权力来防止 GPU 走私。贝森特表示，相反，当局应该妥善执行现有法规。 Bessent 还批评了 Nvidia 的总法律顾问 Timothy Teter，据报道，后者联系了美国商务部，询问美国当局是否是新加坡拘留 Megaspeed 的 Alice Wong 的幕后黑手。然而，如果事实证明英伟达的一些高管知道他们的客户充当中国实体的中间人，财政部长拒绝猜测英伟达可能面临的后果。与此同时，贝森特表示相信英伟达董事会将对此事进行彻底调查。 “但我们只能说，如果发生这种情况，那么该公司没有强有力的控制，”贝森特说。 “我们不知道黄仁勋是否知道这一点。[总委员会]似乎在这方面参与得非常多，可能应该做更多的监督，而不是[美国商务部的政府官员]喋喋不休。”贝森特还透露，财政部、陆军部、国务院以及美国国务院
几个月来，美国贸易代表办公室 (USTR) 一直支持将 Megaspeed 添加到实体名单中。然而，实施此类出口限制的权力属于商务部工业和安全局 (BIS)。据报道，由于商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克 (Howard Lutnick) 担心此举可能会加剧与中国的贸易紧张局势，该局数月来一直搁置将 Megaspeed 列入黑名单的努力。

Scott Bessent, U.S. Treasury Secretary, admitted that the U.S. export controls cannot prevent all the restricted hardware from reaching China or other adversaries, which is why the country allegedly obtained millions of restricted AI GPUs from Nvidia . At the same time, he questioned the efficiency of Nvidia's internal controls. called for accountability at Nvidia, criticized the company's general counsel, but stressed that it was unclear whether Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang knew about the potentially illicit practices. Rubin in-depth The Stout Owl: The ultimate Noctua G2 PC "I think that there is a lot of leakage in the system, and we are constantly working to close that down," in an interview with CNBC (via @siliconmemes ). "One thing here is that the story has been thus far on Jensen Huang's personal foibles. The real story here should be, did Nvidia know their client? And was there a robust effort at Nvidia to make sure that there was no leakage and that they were selling to what were obviously pass-through shell companies? And I think it is important that anyone at the company there be held accountable for that." Bessent admitted that despite strict U.S. export controls that prohibit sales of advanced AI GPUs to China, considerable quantities of restricted hardware may still make their way to the country. However, the Treasury Secretary does not believe that the U.S. needs to introduce more stringent export restrictions or grant government agencies additional powers to prevent GPU smuggling. Instead, the authorities should properly enforce existing regulations, according to Bessent. Bessent also criticized Nvidia's general counsel Timothy Teter, who reportedly contacted the U.S. Department of Commerce to inquire whether U.S. authorities were behind the detention of Megaspeed's Alice Wong in Singapore. However, the Treasury Secretary declined to speculate about potential consequences for Nvidia if it turned out that some of its executives knew that their customers acted as intermediaries for Chinese entities. Meanwhile, Bessent expressed confidence that Nvidia's board of directors would conduct a thorough investigation into the matter. "But let us just say, if this was happening, then there were not robust controls at the company," Bessent said. "We do not know for a fact that Jensen Huang knew this. The [general council] seems to have been very involved here, probably should have done more oversight rather than the haranguing [government officials at the U.S. DoC]." Bessent also revealed that the Departments of the Treasury, War, and State, as well as the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR), had supported the addition of Megaspeed to the Entity List for months. However, the authority to impose such export restrictions belongs to the Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS), which reportedly stalled efforts to blacklist Megaspeed for months as Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick feared that the move could worsen trade tensions with China.

title: Hong Kong Judiciary issues binding rules making litigation ‘last resort’ for Wang Fuk Court fire claims
zh_title: 香港司法机构发布具有约束力的规则，使诉讼成为宏福法院火灾索赔的“最后手段”
summary: 香港司法机构发布了一套具有约束力的程序规则，要求受火灾影响的宏福苑的前居民在向香港法院正式提出民事索赔之前，必须用尽其他赔偿选择，作为“最后的手段”。宏福苑，2026 年 8 月 20 日。摄影：Kyle Lam。司法机构在周四的一份声明中表示，由于去年 11 月的致命火灾造成“大量人员伤亡和严重损害”，“涉及复杂问题和巨额金额的大量索赔可能很快就会提交法院”。 “考虑到时间、成本和不确定性
content:
香港司法机构发布了一套具有约束力的程序规则，要求受火灾影响的宏福苑的前居民在向香港法院正式提出民事索赔之前，必须用尽其他赔偿选择，作为“最后的手段”。宏福苑，2026 年 8 月 20 日。摄影：Kyle Lam。司法机构在周四的一份声明中表示，由于去年 11 月的致命火灾造成“大量人员伤亡和严重损害”，“涉及复杂问题和巨额金额的大量索赔可能很快就会提交法院”。 “考虑到诉讼所涉及的时间、成本和不确定性，”它表示，首先通过和解或调解解决索赔将符合当事人和公众的利益，而诉讼是最后的手段。声明称，新规则以两套“特别实践说明”的形式立即生效。 “最后手段” 据司法机构称，实践指引旨在“确保司法资源的公平和按比例分配，同时不损害当事人诉诸法庭和公平审判的权利”。宏福苑火灾引起的索赔应首先通过和解方式解决，否则各方应采取调解等其他争议解决方式。它说，诉讼只能是“最后的手段”。
在谈判和争议解决过程中，“当事人应尽最大努力，做出真诚和善意的努力”，而“当且仅当”这些努力未能解决争议时，才应提起诉讼。司法机构。照片：何凯莉/HKFP。当事人还必须向法院解释调解失败的原因以及仍然存在的争议点。如果一方绕过调解而直接向区域法院或高等法院原讼法庭提出申索，法院可将诉讼程序搁置最多六个月，以便双方尝试调解。至于雇员补偿索偿及小额钱债审裁处的案件，诉讼程序也可能会押后约四个月，以方便和解或调解。如果这些解决尝试不成功，则将在未来六到九个月内安排针对员工赔偿的听证会，以及针对小额索赔法庭的四个月内安排听证会。香港大律师公会调解委员会主席凌俊伟向《明报》表示，虽然操作指引提出了新要求，但“不会阻止你提起诉讼”。他还表示，值得考虑诉讼权利是否受到影响，同时指出新要求并没有过度限制，并指出根据标准民事审判程序至少需要等待六个月才能安排听证会日期。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong’s Judiciary has issued a set of binding procedural rules requiring former residents of the fire-hit Wang Fuk Court to exhaust other options for compensation before formally filing civil claims at the city’s courts as a “last resort.” Wang Fuk Court on August 20, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam. The Judiciary said in a Thursday statement that “a large number of claims involving complex issues and substantial sums may soon be brought before the courts” owing to the “extensive casualties and severe damage” caused by the deadly blaze last November. “Bearing in mind the time, costs and uncertainties involved in litigation,” it said that resolving claims initially through settlement or mediation would serve the interests of the parties and the public, with litigation as a last resort. The new rules, taking the form of two sets of “Special Practice Notes,” have taken immediate effect, according to the statement. ‘Last resort’ According to the Judiciary, the practice notes intend “to ensure a fair and proportionate distribution of judicial resources without impairing the parties’ right to access to court and a fair trial.” It said that claims arising from the Wang Fuk Court fire should be resolved first by settlement, failing which parties should proceed with alternative dispute resolution methods such as mediation. Litigation should only be a “last resort,” it said. “The parties shall use their best endeavours and make genuine and bona fide efforts” in the negotiation and dispute resolution processes, while litigation should be commenced “if and only if” those efforts failed to resolve the dispute. The Judiciary. Photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. Parties must also explain to the court their reasons for failed mediation and the points of dispute that remain. If a party bypasses mediation and files a claim directly with the District Court or the Court of First Instance of the High Court, the court may put proceedings on hold for up to six months to allow the parties to attempt mediation. For Employees’ Compensation claims and cases in the Small Claims Tribunal, proceedings may also be adjourned for about four months to facilitate settlement or mediation. If those resolution attempts are unsuccessful, hearings will be scheduled within the next six to nine months for Employees’ Compensation and within four months for the Small Claims Tribunal. Chairman of the Hong Kong Bar Association’s Committee on Mediation Ling Chun-wai told Ming Pao that while the practice notes impose new requirements, they “will not stop you from litigating.” He was also quoted as saying that it was worth considering whether the right to litigate had been affected, while noting that the new requirements were not overly restrictive, pointing to the wait of at least six months to have a hearing date scheduled under standard civil trial procedures.

title: 北京大董村访民曝五中全会期间被清零经历

content: 【大纪元2026年11月11日讯】（大纪元记者李熙采访报导）中共五中全会已经闭幕，但是会议期间租住在房山区阎村镇大董村的访民都被当局给清零。近日，福建两访民曝在访民村被维稳经历，感叹底层最无助的受害人不该成为当权者打压的对象。 大董村位于北京市房山区郊区，房租相对低廉，是访民、打工人租屋首选。因此每当中共召开重要会议或敏感时期，当地常传出“清零”或强制遣返行动。 王秀英：维稳将成历史耻辱 福建访民王秀英，因村集体土地问题维权二十多年得不到解决，今年首次进京上访，就租屋在大董村。这次因五中全会敏感期被维稳，让她见证了“上访难”。 10月26日，福建地方政府与公安来到大董村，说会议期间她（王秀英）的脸不能在北京出现，要她离开北京。26日下午，她被地方维稳人员带去济南“旅游”，直至29日下午5点半，经上级领导允许她才回到北京。 王秀英称自己不算上访专业户，但也是这次被清零的对象。近日，她将被维稳经历发到网上。 她说，她在福建的老家，因村集体土地被侵害，走完全部司法程序已经二十多年，问题依然得不到解决。最后地方政府让她找“有权机关”解决，于是她来到北京上访，白天没事就出去打零工，晚上回大董村。 “我不扰民，没违法。然后五中全会期间，地方的人来找我说：敏感时期，先回去。”王秀英不解，“国家开个会和我没关系，为什么开个会就‘敏感时期’了？地方政府把国家的会期、日程称为敏感期，那制造‘敏感’的是国家高层领导，不是我们这些被欠了二十年公道的人造成的。” 10月29日五中全会闭幕，但是全国维稳并未结束，当日下午，王秀英和维稳人员来到济南动车站，发现都是警察和警车，到北京的旅客要两道安检。此时她才知道，自己的身份证被标注了“访民”，使她无法顺利通过安检，最后是她身边的国保出示了警官证，并留了电话号码才让她进地铁站。 王秀英表示，“我今年才上京信访，他们却在我的身份证上做了标识。政府掠夺百姓财产，法院枉法裁判，检察院不履行监督，向国家权力机关反映，就给了一个‘访民’的标签，让访民成为异类。” “我到北京打工已经5个月，地方政府派两个人长驻北京看守我，他们就是这样以权力拿走百姓的财产，再用百姓的财产维稳受害的百姓。这个时代将成为历史的耻辱！” 政府粗暴维稳 访民无奈 另据知情人士爆料，福建访民张华，也是租屋在北京大董村。10月23日晚上，福州维稳干部陈积雄纠集多名人员，在无任何合法手续的情况下，暴力踢破张华租屋的门，当场控制了张华、陈义坤夫妇，并强行扣押二人手机、身份证，切断所有对外通讯求助管道，随后将二人强行押送至福州鸿瑞宾馆，分开关押拘禁。 拘禁期间，张华手部被玻璃划伤，伤口残留玻璃异物。张华多次要求就医遭拒。且在拘禁期间，两次不给张华提供饭食。后张华冒险逃出宾馆，脱离控制后自行前往福州医院手术治疗。目前，张华已经回到家中，地方政府派人在张华家门口蹲守。 而陈义坤在关押期间也曾试图逃跑，被当场抓回，遭到皮带捆绑、强行拖拽，继续非法拘禁看管。10月30日陈义坤恢复人身自由回家。当日下午，维稳人员才归还两部手机、张华身份证，但两部手机内的SIM卡全部被取走。

zh_title: USNI 新闻西太平洋脉搏：2026 年 11 月 13 日
summary: 以下是上周西太平洋主要舰船活动和演习的摘要。 2026 年 11 月 9 日，新加坡，一名隶属于第 137 电子攻击中队 (VAQ) 的美国水手在尼米兹级航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71) 机库湾对 E/A-18G 咆哮者进行维护。美国海军照片 西奥多·罗斯福号航母打击群于周日从新加坡出发。该打击群包括西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰（CVN-71）及其第11舰载机联队（CVW）、长津号巡洋舰（CG-65）和保罗·汉密尔顿号驱逐舰（DDG-6）
content:
以下是上周西太平洋主要舰船活动和演习的摘要。 2026 年 11 月 9 日，新加坡，一名隶属于第 137 电子攻击中队 (VAQ) 的美国水手在尼米兹级航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71) 机库湾对 E/A-18G 咆哮者进行维护。美国海军照片 西奥多·罗斯福号航母打击群于周日从新加坡出发。该打击群包括西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰（CVN-71）及其第11舰载机联队（CVW）、长津号巡洋舰（CG-65）以及保罗·汉密尔顿号驱逐舰（DDG-60）和迪凯特号（DDG-73）。西奥多·罗斯福、长津和迪凯特向西航行进入马六甲海峡，而保罗·汉密尔顿则向东航行进入南中国海。西奥多·罗斯福号、长津号和迪凯特号目前正在印度洋前往美国中央司令部。日本横须贺附近 印度海军 Shivalik 级隐形多用途护卫舰 INS Sahyadri (F 49)、日本海上自卫队日向级直升机驱逐舰 JS Ise (DDH 182)、最上级护卫舰 JS Mogami (FFM 1)、澳大利亚皇家海军安扎克级护卫舰 HMAS Stuart (FFH 153) 和美国海军 San 2026 年 11 月 7 日，安东尼奥级两栖运输船坞运输舰安克雷奇号 (LPD-23) 和约翰·穆萨号 (LPD-26) 在 2026 年马拉巴尔演习期间在西太平洋编队航行。美国海军照片 2026 年马拉巴尔四方演习于周四在日本横须贺附近海域结束。
参与的资产包括日本海上自卫队直升机驱逐舰 JS Ise (DDH-182)、护卫舰 JS Mogami (FFM-1)、日本海上自卫队潜艇和 P-1 海上巡逻机 (MPA)、印度海军护卫舰 INS Sahyadri (F49)、澳大利亚皇家海军护卫舰 HMAS Stuart (FFH153) 和澳大利亚皇家空军 P-8A Poseidon MPA、美国海军 P-8A 海神 MPA 和两栖运输船坞 USS Anchorage (LPD-23) 和 USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26)。安克雷奇号和约翰·P·穆萨号与两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 以及已登船的第 13 海军陆战队远征部队组成了马金岛两栖待命大队。据当地船舶观察员称，这三艘船均于周六从横须贺舰队活动司令部（CFAY）出发。 2026 年 11 月 8 日，在日本横须贺，美国海军陆战队海军陆战队海军陆战队中型倾转旋翼机中队 (VMM) 364（加强型）的飞行员从圣安东尼奥级两栖运输船坞舰安克雷奇 (LPD-23) 的飞行甲板上驾驶一架 MV-22B 鱼鹰。美国海军照片安克雷奇于周五返回横须贺，目前停泊据当地船舶观察员称，那里近海。据当地船舶观察员称，澳大利亚皇家海军斯图尔特号护卫舰在参加 2026 年马拉巴尔演习后于周四返回横须贺。据当地船舶观察员称，印度海军护卫舰 INS Sahyadri 于周四返回横须贺，并于周五离开。
据当地船舶观测员称，潜艇补给船弗兰克·凯布尔号 (AS-40) 于周三驶入横须贺指挥官舰队活动基地。在西太平洋，隶属于海军陆战队中型倾转旋翼机中队 (VMM) 364 的美国海军陆战队 CH-53 种马准备从圣安东尼奥级两栖运输船坞舰约翰·P·穆萨号 (LPD-26) 的飞行甲板起飞， 2026 年 11 月 9 日。美国海军照片 两栖攻击舰马金岛号和两栖运输船坞约翰·P·穆萨号正在美国第七舰队作战区域航行。在菲律宾海 台湾民族党秘书长吴钊燮于 2026 年 11 月 12 日发布的图片

【原文 English Original】
The following is a summary of major ship movements and exercises in the Western Pacific over the last week. In Singapore A U.S. sailor assigned to Electronic Attack Squadron (VAQ) 137 conducts maintenance on an E/A-18G Growler in the hangar bay of Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71), Nov. 9, 2026. US Navy photo The Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group departed on Sunday from Singapore. The strike group includes aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) with embarked carrier air wing (CVW) 11, cruiser USS Chosin (CG-65) and destroyers USS Paul Hamilton (DDG-60) and USS Decatur (DDG-73). Theodore Roosevelt , Chosin and Decatur sailed west to enter the Malacca Strait while Paul Hamilton sailed east into the South China Sea. Theodore Roosevelt , Chosin and Decatur are now in the Indian Ocean en route to U.S. Central Command. Near Yokosuka, Japan Indian Navy Shivalik-class stealth multi-role frigate INS Sahyadri (F 49), Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force Hyuga-class helicopter destroyer JS Ise (DDH 182), Mogami-class frigate JS Mogami (FFM 1), Royal Australian Navy Anzac-class frigate HMAS Stuart (FFH 153) and U.S. Navy San Antonio-class amphibious transport docks USS Anchorage (LPD-23) and USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26) sail in formation in the Western Pacific Ocean during Exercise Malabar 2026, Nov. 7, 2026. US Navy photo Quad Exercise Malabar 2026 wrapped up Thursday in the waters near Yokosuka, Japan. Participating assets were Japan Maritime Self Defense Force helicopter destroyer JS Ise (DDH-182), frigate JS Mogami (FFM-1), a JMSDF submarine and a P-1 Maritime Patrol Aircraft (MPA), Indian Navy frigate INS Sahyadri (F49), Royal Australian Navy frigate HMAS Stuart (FFH153) and a Royal Australian Air Force P-8A Poseidon MPA, a U.S. Navy P-8A Poseidon MPA and amphibious transport docks USS Anchorage (LPD-23) and USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26). Anchorage and John P. Murtha with amphibious assault ship USS Makin Island (LHD-8) and the embarked 13th Marine Expeditionary Unit form the Makin Island Amphibious Ready Group. All three ships departed Saturday from Commander Fleet Activities Yokosuka (CFAY), according to local ship spotters . In Yokosuka, Japan U.S. Marine Corps Marines, pilots assigned to Marine Medium Tiltrotor Squadron (VMM) 364 (Reinforced), fly an MV-22B Osprey from the flight deck aboard San Antonio-class amphibious transport dock ship USS Anchorage (LPD-23), Nov. 8, 2026. US Navy photo Anchorage returned to Yokosuka on Friday and is currently anchored offshore there, according to local ship spotters . RAN frigate HMAS Stuart returned on Thursday to Yokosuka after its participation in Exercise Malabar 2026, according to local ship spotters . Indian Navy frigate INS Sahyadri returned on Thursday to Yokosuka and departed on Friday, according to local ship spotters . Submarine tender USS Frank Cable (AS-40) pulled into Commander Fleet Activities Yokosuka on Wednesday, according to local ship spotters . In the Western Pacific A U.S. Marine Corps CH-53 Stallion, attached to Marine Medium Tiltrotor Squadron (VMM) 364, prepares to take off from the flight deck aboard San Antonio-class amphibious transport dock ship USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26), Nov. 9, 2026. US Navy photo Amphibious assault ship Makin Island and amphibious transport dock John P. Murtha are underway in U.S. 7th Fleet area of operations. In the Philippine Sea A graphic posted Nov. 12, 2026, by Joseph Wu, Secretary General of Taiwan’s National Security Council. Taiwan National Security Council graphic The People’s Liberation Army Navy Liaoning CSG is operating in the Philippine Sea waters east of the Philippine island of Samar as of Thursday, according to a graphic posted by Joseph Wu, Secretary General of Taiwan’s National Security Council. The CSG was last visually sighted in October. The Liaoning CSG previously included aircraft carrier CNS Liaoning (16) cruisers CNS Anshan (101) and CNS Wuxi (104) and destroyer CNS Huainan (123) but the accompanying ships to the carrier may have changed since. In the South China Sea (L-R) Able Seaman Maritime Logistic – Supply Chain Leah Locke and Able Seaman Maritime Logistic – Supply Chain Grace Reading lay wreaths during a wreath laying ceremony for Remembrance Day during a Regional Presence Deployment 2026 on Nov. 10, 2026. Australian Defense photo Royal Australian Navy fleet oiler HMAS Stalwart (A304) is operating in the South China Sea waters near Brunei on the Royal Australian Navy’s regional presence deployment. On Wednesday , the ship conducted a Remembrance Day wreath laying ceremony with Royal Brunei Navy offshore patrol vessel KDB Darulaman (08). In Guam The ROKN Joint Cruise Training Task Force, 741 second year cadets from three service academies and the Armed Forces Nursing Academy were in Guam for a port visit on Nov. 9, 2026. US Navy photo The ROKN Joint Cruise Training Task Force, 741 second year cadets from three service academies and the Armed Forces Nursing Academy were in Guam as of Monday on a port visit. The task force includes amphibious assault ship ROKS Marado (LPH-6112) and amphibious landing ships ROKS Ilchulbong (LST-688) and ROKS Nojeokbong (LST-689), along with embarked Republic of Korea Marine Corps (ROKMC) MUH-1 Marineon helicopters. In Kangwon Province, North Korea North Korea leader Kim Jong Un inspected the construction site of a new naval base on Nov. 11, 2026, in Thongchon County, Kangwon Province. State media Korea Central News Agency photo North Korea leader Kim Jong Un inspected the construction site of a new naval base on Wednesday in Thongchon County, Kangwon Province, located on North Korea’s east coast, state media Korean Central News Agency reported. In Maizuru, Japan Royal Navy offshore patrol vessel HMS Spey (P234) departed JMSDF Maizuru Naval Base on Nov. 10, 2026. JMSDF photo Royal Navy offshore patrol vessel HMS Spey (P234) departed JMSDF Maizuru Naval Base on Tuesday after completing a five-day port visit that began on Nov. 6. Spey with sister ship HMS Tamar (P233) are forwarded deployed to the Indo-Pacific. Near Yonaguni Island and Taiwan A Chinese BZK-005 reconnaissance UAV on Nov. 11, 2026. Japan Joint Staff Office photo On Wednesday, a suspected Chinese Unmanned Aerial Vehicle flew in from the East China Sea, passed between Yonaguni Island and Taiwan and reached the Philippine Sea. The UAV then turned back when it reached a point east of the northeast tip of Taiwan and flew between Yonaguni Island and Taiwan to return to the East China Sea. Fighter aircraft from the Japan Air Self-Defense Force Southwestern Air Defense Command were scrambled in response. Also on Wednesday, a Chinese BZK-005 reconnaissance UAV flew in from the East China Sea, passing between Yonaguni Island and Taiwan to enter the Philippine Sea. The drone then flew south until it was east of the northwest tip of Taiwan and conducted a circuit flight before returning back the same way to the East China Sea. JASDF fighter aircraft from the JASDF Southwestern Air Defense Command were scrambled in response. Suspected Chinese UAV flight paths on Nov. 11, 2026. Japan Joint Staff Office map On Thursday, a suspected Chinese UAV flew in from the East China Sea and entered the Philippine Sea, flying between Yonaguni Island and Taiwan. The suspected drone was east of the northeast tip of Taiwan before its track was lost. Later that same day, another suspected Chinese UAV was tracked from the Philippine Sea east of the northeast tip of Taiwan. The UAV flew north and entered the East China Sea after flying between Yonaguni Island and Taiwan. Japan’s Joint Staff Office issued a news release on the flights, indicating the flights were conducted by different UAVs. Fighter aircraft from the JASDF Southwestern Air Defense Command were scrambled to intercept. In the East China Sea A Chinese Y-9 Electronic Intelligence aircraft on Nov. 10, 2026. Japan Joint Staff Office photo On Tuesday, a Chinese Y-9 Electronic Intelligence aircraft flew in from China and flew from an area south of the Danjo Islands in the East China Sea to a position northwest of Okinawa. After completing a patrol circuit, the Y-9 flew back to China. In response, JASDF fighter aircraft were scrambled. In the Miyako Strait PLAN destroyer CNS Qiqihar (121) and fast combat support ship CNS Hulunhu (901) on Nov. 10, 2026. Japan Joint Staff Office photo PLAN destroyer CNS Qiqihar (121) and fast combat support ship CNS Hulunhu (901) were spotted on Thursday sailing south 60 kilometers – 37 miles – west of Kume Island. The ships sailed southeast between Okinawa and Miyako Island to enter the Philippine Sea. A JMSDF P-1 MPA of Fleet Air Wing 1 and a JMSDF P-3C Orion MPA shadowed the PLAN ships. In La Pérouse Strait A Russian Navy Kilo-class submarine, amphibious landing ship RFS Nikolai Vilkov (081) and tugboat Fotiy Krylov on Nov. 10, 2026. Japan Joint Staff Office photo A Russian Navy Kilo-class submarine, amphibious landing ship RFS Nikolai Vilkov (081) and tugboat Fotiy Krylov were sighted sailing west 40 kilometers – 25 miles – northeast of Cape Soya on the main island of Hokkaido late Tuesday. From Tuesday to Wednesday, the submarine and ships sailed west through La Pérouse Strait, which separates Hokkaido from Russia’s Sakhalin Island, to enter the Sea of Japan. JMSDF fast attack craft JS Umitaka (PG-828) and a JMSDF P-3C Orion MPA shadowed the Russian submarine and ships. This post was written by Dzirhan Mahadzir.

title: Long-awaited Hong Kong sex offences reform bill to be gazetted Friday
zh_title: 期待已久的香港性犯罪改革法案将于周五刊宪
summary: 一系列期待已久的性犯罪改革，包括将持续性儿童性虐待和“网络闪光”定为刑事犯罪，已定于本周五在宪报刊登，该法案将于本月晚些时候在立法机关进行审查。由针对妇女的性暴力协会出版的关于性侵犯和性法律改革的小册子。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 《2026年性罪行法例（修订）条例草案》旨在实现两项政策目标，即加强对性罪行受害者的保护，以及使香港有关性罪行的法律现代化，以跟上时代的步伐。
content:
一系列期待已久的性犯罪改革，包括将持续性儿童性虐待和“网络闪光”定为刑事犯罪，已定于本周五在宪报刊登，该法案将于本月晚些时候在立法机关进行审查。由针对妇女的性暴力协会出版的关于性侵犯和性法律改革的小册子。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。保安局在周三的一份声明中表示，《2026年性犯罪法例（修订）条例草案》旨在实现两个政策目标，即加强对性犯罪受害者的保护，以及使香港有关性犯罪的法律与时俱进。报告称，改革旨在审查该市已有数十年历史的性犯罪法律并使其更新，“以解决现行规定的不足之处，并应对与性犯罪有关的社会观念的变化”。 “与时俱进” 该法律草案将于本周五在政府公报上公布，然后于11月25日提交立法会。政府的目标是在明年6月本届任期结束前完成立法工作。该局发言人表示：“我们希望完善香港有关性犯罪的法律，越早越好，加强对性犯罪受害者的保护，同时确保有关性犯罪的法律能够与时俱进。”香港立法会。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。
这项立法改革在今年 7 月首次提出时，遭到了要求加强保护的呼声，其中包括缺乏持续的儿童性虐待罪。在这些呼声之后，政府于 9 月提议制定新的罪行，将长期和反复性虐待儿童以及未经同意发送生殖器数码照片（称为“网络闪光”）定为刑事犯罪。作为性犯罪改革的一部分，政府提出了两种新的罪行来代替非礼：涉及触摸的性侵犯和不触摸的性侵犯。它还寻求扩大强奸的范围，以涵盖男性和变性幸存者。与此同时，倡导团体继续呼吁政府对允许性侵犯嫌疑人声称他们错误地认为自己已获得同意的辩护施加限制。

【原文 English Original】
A long-awaited slate of sex crime reforms including the criminalisation of persistent child sexual abuse and “cyberflashing” has been set to be gazetted this Friday, with the bill due for scrutiny at the legislature later this month. Booklets published by Association Concerning Sexual Violence Against Women on sexual assault and sexual law reform. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The Sexual Offences Legislation (Amendment) Bill 2026 “aims to achieve two policy objectives, namely, strengthening protection for victims of sexual offences, and modernising the laws on sexual offences in Hong Kong to keep pace with the times,” the Security Bureau said in a Wednesday statement. The reforms aim to review the city’s decades-old sex crimes laws and bring them up to date, “to address the inadequacies of the current provisions and respond to changes in social perceptions related to sexual offences,” it said. ‘Keep pace with the times’ The draft law will be published in the government gazette this Friday before being introduced to the Legislative Council on November 25. The government aims to complete the legislative exercise before its current term ends in June next year. “We hope to improve the laws on sexual offences in Hong Kong, the earlier the better, to strengthen protection for victims of sexual offences while ensuring that the laws on sexual offences can keep pace with the times,” the bureau’s spokesperson said. Hong Kong Legislative Council. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The legislative revamp was met with calls for stronger protections when it was first put forward this July, including over its lack of a persistent child sexual abuse offence. Following those calls, the government in September proposed creating new offences to criminalise prolonged and repeated sexual abuse against children as well as sending digital pictures of one’s genitals without consent, known as “cyberflashing.” As part of the sex crime reforms, the government has proposed two new offences in place of indecent assault: sexual assault involving touching and sexual assault without touching. It also seeks to expand the scope of rape to cover male and transgender survivors. Meanwhile, advocacy groups have continued to call on the government to impose limits on a defence allowing a sexual assault suspect to claim they mistakenly believed they had been given consent.

title: Hong Kong receives 16 expressions of interest for Northern Metropolis logistics cluster
zh_title: 香港收到16份发展北都物流集群的意向书
summary: 政府表示，香港北部都会洪水桥/厦村发展区规划中的物流集群已收到 16 份意向书。这张航拍照片显示的是2026年10月30日，即将建成的洪水桥地铁站附近的益园村正在被拆除。照片的右上角显示了洪水桥大学城校园区规划的大片区域。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。当局周五宣布，这 16 份意见书来自开发商、物流运营商、行业协会和专业服务机构。
content:
政府表示，香港北部都会洪水桥/厦村发展区规划中的物流集群已收到 16 份意向书。这张航拍照片显示的是2026年10月30日，即将建成的洪水桥地铁站附近的益园村正在被拆除。照片的右上角显示了洪水桥大学城校园区规划的大片区域。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。当局周五宣布，这 16 份意见书来自开发商、物流运营商、行业协会和专业服务提供商，但没有透露具体姓名。他们表示对洪水桥/厦村新发展区一块约32公顷的土地感兴趣，当局已预留该土地用于在北方大都市西部建设“现代物流集群”。运输及物流局和土木工程拓展署负责监管这部分工程。 TLB 发言人表示，当局将开始分析提交的材料，以促进正式招标的规划和准备。该发言人补充道：“我们预计最早将于 2027 年底对第一批可用场地进行招标，并争取在 2028 年授予相关招标。”
政府表示，洪水桥/厦村物流集群将靠近深圳湾口岸，并连接香港国际机场和葵青货柜码头。立法会周四通过专门立法，简化监管程序并加快北部都会区的发展，该计划将把靠近深圳边境的香港约三分之一的土地转变为创新和科技中心。另请参阅：科技城到大学城：香港北部大都市为何将重点从高科技转向高等教育 当局表示，该大型项目的重点将是三个大学城，而之前提出的开发名为新田科技城的科技中心的要求则有所不同。

【原文 English Original】
A planned logistics cluster in the Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen development area in Hong Kong’s Northern Metropolis has received 16 expression-of-interest submissions, the government has said. This aerial photo shows the demolition of Yik Yuen Tsuen, a village near the future Hung Shui Kiu MTR station, October 30, 2026. On the top right corner of the photo shows a large area planned for the campus area of the Hung Shui Kiu University Town. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Authorities announced on Friday that the 16 submissions came from developers, logistics operators, industry associations and professional services providers, without naming them. They were signalling interest in a roughly 32-hectare land plot in the Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen New Development Area that authorities have reserved for building a “modern logistics cluster” in the western part of the Northern Metropolis. The Transport and Logistics Bureau (TLB) and the Civil Engineering and Development Department oversee this part of the project. A TLB spokesperson said authorities would start analysing the submissions to facilitate planning and the preparation of a formal tender. “We expect to invite tenders for the first available site(s) in end [of] 2027 at the earliest, with a view to awarding the relevant tender in 2028,” the spokesperson added. The Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen logistics cluster will be close to the Shenzhen Bay Port and connected to the Hong Kong International Airport and the Kwai Tsing Container Terminals, the government has said. Lawmakers on Thursday passed dedicated legislation that will streamline regulatory procedures and expedite the Northern Metropolis development, which is set to transform about a third of Hong Kong’s land area near its border with Shenzhen into an innovation and tech hub. See also: Technopole to University Towns: Why Hong Kong’s Northern Metropolis shifted focus from hi-tech to higher ed Authorities have said that the focus of the megaproject will be three university towns – shifting from the previously stated imperative of developing a tech hub known as the San Tin Technopole.

title: Chips prohibidos de Nvidia terminaron en centro de datos ligado a Alice Huang en China, revelan documentos
zh_title: 文件显示，被禁的 Nvidia 芯片最终被运往与 Alice Huang 有关的中国数据中心
summary: 据彭博新闻社查阅的文件显示，由爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）创立的一家中国公司购买了走私的人工智能芯片，这些芯片安装在与 Megaspeed International 相连的上海数据中心。据一位知情人士透露，其中一些服务器最初出售给位于新加坡的 Nvidia 官方云合作伙伴 Aperia Cloud Services。由于该话题的敏感性，该人士要求匿名。然而，与其留下
content:
据彭博新闻社查阅的文件显示，由爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）创立的一家中国公司购买了走私的人工智能芯片，这些芯片安装在与 Megaspeed International 相连的上海数据中心。据一位知情人士透露，其中一些服务器最初出售给位于新加坡的 Nvidia 官方云合作伙伴 Aperia Cloud Services。由于该话题的敏感性，该人士要求匿名。然而，文件显示，这些设备并没有留在那个岛国，而是最终落入了爱丽丝在上海一家庞大的人工智能设施中创立的一家中国公司手中。该项目与她有多个联系，包括她于 2023 年创立的 Megaspeed 公司在 2024 年的投资者演示中使用了数据中心的图形表示。这些文件提供了迄今为止最明确的证据，表明以 Alice 为中心的广泛中国公司网络成功获得了走私的 Nvidia 设备。事实上，这是通过 Nvidia 云合作伙伴而不是 Megaspeed 发生的，该公司也因涉嫌转移半导体而受到怀疑。
这违反了美国的贸易限制，引发了人们对英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋与一名他承认有婚外关系的女性之间关系的新质疑。这场争议引发了一场风暴，导致他离职，并在整个人工智能行业产生了反响。这就是与 Alice Huang 相关的 Nvidia 芯片如何到达中国的具体情况。具体来说，Aperia 从戴尔科技公司购买了 22 台包含 Nvidia H800 芯片的服务器，这些服务器在 2023 年向中国销售受到华盛顿的限制。彭博社向一位知情人士提供了这些服务器的序列号，该人士证实 Aperia 是戴尔客户。戴尔在一份声明中指出，“出于对未经授权转移设备的担忧，该公司于 2025 年 2 月暂停了对 Aperia International 的所有销售和支持。”同月，新加坡逮捕了 Aperia 的首席执行官，罪名是对服务器供应商进行欺诈。该经理不认罪，正在等待审判。同年 5 月，詹森表示“没有证据”表明芯片被转移。英伟达此前曾指出，当其首席执行官被捕时，Aperia 不再是活跃客户。此后，该公司还将 Aperia 从 Nvidia Cloud 合作伙伴的公开列表中删除。
Aperia 否认有任何不当行为，周四拒绝通过电话发表评论，也没有回复有关该团队及其与 Alice Huang 关系的电子邮件问题。周五，新加坡检察官起诉了与此案有关的第五人。 Aperia 从戴尔购买的设备详细记录在上海龙腾智能计算子公司提交的文件中，龙腾智能计算是 Alice 十年前创建的一家公司。根据向中央政府提交的记录，这些文件包括安装在上海的一组 193 台服务器，这家中国公司将这些服务器作为抵押品，以在 2025 年 1 月获得融资。中国企业有义务

【原文 English Original】
Una empresa china fundada por Alice Huang , la mujer en el centro de la controversia que persigue a Nvidia , adquirió chips de inteligencia artificial de contrabando que fueron instalados en un centro de datos de Shanghái vinculado con Megaspeed International , de acuerdo con documentos revisados por Bloomberg News . Algunos de los servidores fueron vendidos originalmente a Aperia Cloud Services , un socio oficial de Nvidia Cloud con sede en Singapur, según una persona familiarizada con el asunto, que solicitó el anonimato debido a la sensibilidad del tema. Sin embargo, en lugar de permanecer en ese país insular, los documentos muestran que el equipo terminó en manos de una empresa china fundada por Alice , en una extensa instalación de inteligencia artificial en Shanghái . El proyecto tiene varios vínculos con ella, entre ellos que Megaspeed, compañía que fundó en 2023, utilizó una representación gráfica del centro de datos en una presentación para inversionistas en 2024. Los documentos ofrecen hasta ahora la evidencia más explícita de que una amplia red de empresas chinas, con Alice en el centro, logró obtener equipos de Nvidia introducidos de contrabando. Esto ocurrió, de hecho, a través de un socio de Nvidia Cloud distinto de Megaspeed, empresa que también está bajo sospecha por el presunto desvío de semiconductores . Se trata de una violación de las restricciones comerciales de Estados Unidos que plantea nuevas preguntas sobre la relación entre Jensen Huang, exdirector ejecutivo de Nvidia , y una mujer con quien reconoció haber mantenido una relación extramarital. La controversia desató una tormenta que provocó su salida y generó repercusiones en toda la industria de la inteligencia artificial . Así llegaron a China los chips Nvidia vinculados con Alice Huang En concreto, Aperia compró 22 servidores a Dell Technologies Inc. que contenían chips Nvidia H800 , cuya venta a China fue restringida por Washington en 2023. Bloomberg proporcionó los números de serie de esos servidores a una persona familiarizada con la transacción, quien confirmó que Aperia era cliente de Dell. En un comunicado, Dell señaló que “suspendió todas las ventas y el soporte a Aperia International en febrero de 2025 debido a preocupaciones por el desvío no autorizado de equipos ”. Ese mismo mes, Singapur arrestó al director ejecutivo de Aperia bajo cargos de fraude contra proveedores de servidores. El directivo se declaró inocente y está a la espera de juicio. En mayo de ese año, Jensen declaró que no había “evidencia” de desvío de chips. Nvidia había señalado anteriormente que Aperia ya no era un cliente activo cuando su director ejecutivo fue arrestado. Desde entonces, la compañía también eliminó a Aperia de su lista pública de socios de Nvidia Cloud. Aperia, que ha negado cualquier irregularidad, declinó hacer comentarios por teléfono el jueves y no respondió a preguntas enviadas por correo electrónico sobre el equipo y su relación con Alice Huang. El viernes, fiscales de Singapur acusaron a una quinta persona en relación con el caso. Los equipos que Aperia compró a Dell aparecen detallados en documentos presentados por una filial de Shanghai Longteng Intelligent Computing , empresa creada por Alice hace una década. Los documentos incluyen un grupo de 193 servidores instalados en Shanghái que la compañía china ofreció como garantía para obtener financiamiento en enero de 2025, según registros presentados ante el gobierno central. Las empresas chinas están obligadas por ley a proporcionar determinados detalles de sus contratos de financiamiento a una base de datos administrada por la agencia de crédito del Banco Popular de China. La hermana de Alice y los 73 mdd en servidores Nvidia Los registros no especifican cómo se obtuvieron los chips Nvidia en cuestión ni si Alice participó personalmente en esa transacción. Ella cedió sus acciones de Shanghai Longteng en 2017 y un nuevo accionista llamado Huang Yu tomó el control, de acuerdo con una base de datos oficial del registro corporativo. Huang Yu, identificada por el medio de comunicación The Information como hermana de Alice , mantuvo una participación mayoritaria hasta enero de 2026, según el registro empresarial. Esto significa que supervisó la compañía durante el periodo en que los servidores instalados en Shanghái fueron ofrecidos como garantía. En total, los equipos utilizados como garantía tenían un valor de 485 millones de yuanes ( 73 millones de dólares ), según los documentos. Además de los servidores de Dell, incluían 52 unidades fabricadas por la empresa estadounidense Super Micro Computer Inc., que contenían chips Nvidia H100 o H200 . Ambos modelos tienen restringida su venta a China sin una licencia de Estados Unidos. Bloomberg proporcionó a Super Micro los números de serie de los equipos instalados en Shanghái y preguntó a quién habían sido vendidos originalmente y en qué fecha. La compañía no respondió esas preguntas, pero afirmó que “vendió los servidores identificados en cumplimiento de todas las leyes estadounidenses aplicables sobre controles de exportación y reexportación”. Super Micro agregó que no vendió chips Nvidia a ninguna de las empresas chinas vinculadas con el centro de datos de Shanghái y que no tiene relación alguna con las instalaciones, conocidas como el Proyecto del Delta del Río Yangtsé . El Proyecto del Delta del Río Yangtsé tiene varios vínculos con Alice. De acuerdo con una nota de un medio local de Shanghái, su presidente es Kang Wei, un antiguo socio de negocios que en ocasiones ha sido presentado como pareja sentimental de ella, según personas familiarizadas con el asunto. Kang conoció al director ejecutivo de Nvidia durante la década de 2010, de acuerdo con The Information . Las empresas de Alice Huang que aparecen en la investigación Kang es uno de los principales directivos de Shanghai Hexi , una firma de capital privado que proporcionó respaldo financiero al centro de datos y en la que Alice trabajó anteriormente. En marzo de 2025, un reportaje en video de un medio local lo mostró durante una inspección gubernamental de las instalaciones. En las imágenes se le observa tomando cuidadosamente notas de lo que decían los funcionarios durante la reunión. También está Megaspeed, otra empresa creada por Alice que actualmente es investigada por las autoridades estadounidenses por presuntamente introducir de contrabando chips Nvidia en China . En 2024, Megaspeed utilizó una representación gráfica del Proyecto del Delta del Río Yangtsé en una presentación para inversionistas, en la que lo describió como su mayor instalación de inteligencia artificial : un centro de datos ubicado en una “zona específica” de un país que no identificó. Otra empresa, llamada Shanghai Shuoyao , considerada una especie de filial corporativa de Megaspeed en China, publicó ofertas de empleo para ingenieros que trabajaran con “H100, H200 y otros modelos de GPU”, los chips de Nvidia cuya venta está prohibida, en una dirección ubicada a medio kilómetro de las instalaciones. Bloomberg informó sobre la mayoría de estos vínculos en diciembre de 2025. En ese momento, Nvidia y Megaspeed declinaron responder preguntas sobre el Proyecto del Delta del Río Yangtsé. El más reciente conjunto de documentos va un paso más allá: una filial de la empresa matriz fundada por Alice informó a los reguladores chinos que efectivamente tenía servidores sujetos a restricciones en el centro de datos de Shanghái. Algunos de los chips que contienen esos servidores, los H100 y H200, son los mismos modelos para los que Shanghai Shuoyao estaba buscando contratar a un ingeniero. Nvidia declinó hacer comentarios. Megaspeed, que ha negado categóricamente las acusaciones de contrabando de chips, no respondió a las preguntas. Bloomberg no pudo localizar a Shanghai Longjie Yaoteng, la filial de la empresa china fundada por Alice que reveló la existencia de los servidores en sus documentos. Su empresa matriz, Shanghai Longteng, tampoco respondió a una solicitud de comentarios.

content:
香港海关在机场检获可卡因并逮捕印尼男子中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 15 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
香港海关在机场检获可卡因并逮捕印尼男子
香港海关于2026年11月13日逮捕一名57岁印度尼西亚男子，原因是在其托运行李箱的假底内发现藏有怀疑可卡因。该男子从哥伦比亚波哥大经巴西圣保罗和卡塔尔多哈抵达。
2026 年 11 月 14 日 19:40 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 15 日 04:24 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
香港海关人员在机场发现一名57岁印尼男子托运行李箱的暗格内藏有疑似可卡因，并以涉嫌贩毒的罪名逮捕了他。该男子于2026年11月13日从哥伦比亚波哥大经巴西圣保罗及卡塔尔多哈抵达香港。
海关人员在检查行李时发现可疑包裹，并在行李箱的假底内发现藏有怀疑可卡因。该男子立即被捕。该案仍在调查中。
香港海关表示，将根据情报分析，继续加强打击贩毒活动。发言人呼吁市民保持警惕，不要参与贩毒活动以获取经济利益，也不要接受任何将管制物品运进或运出香港的提议。在未先确认货物性质的情况下，不应帮助他人运输物品。
海关表示，会继续运用风险管理原则，重点对来自高风险地区的旅客进行清关​​检查，确保有效打击跨境贩毒活动。
根据香港《危险药物条例》，贩运危险药物属严重罪行。一经定罪，最高刑罚为罚款港币 500 万元及终身监禁。

Hong Kong customs seize cocaine at airport, arrest Indonesian man | China Labour Bulletin Board
Sunday, 15 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong customs seize cocaine at airport, arrest Indonesian man
Hong Kong customs arrested a 57-year-old Indonesian man on 13 November 2026 after finding suspected cocaine hidden in the false bottom of his checked suitcase. The man had arrived from Bogota, Colombia via Sao Paulo, Brazil and Doha, Qatar.
14 Nov 2026 at 19:40 HKT · updated 15 Nov, 04:24 · 1 min read
Hong Kong customs officers at the airport have arrested a 57-year-old Indonesian man on suspicion of drug trafficking, after discovering suspected cocaine hidden in the false compartment of his checked suitcase. The man arrived in Hong Kong on 13 November 2026 from Bogota, Colombia, via Sao Paulo, Brazil and Doha, Qatar.
Customs officers detected the suspicious package during baggage inspection and found the suspected cocaine concealed in a false bottom of the suitcase. The man was immediately arrested. The case remains under investigation.
Hong Kong customs said it will continue to strengthen enforcement against drug trafficking based on intelligence analysis. It urged the public to remain vigilant and not to participate in drug trafficking activities for financial gain, nor to accept any offer to transport controlled items into or out of Hong Kong. People should not help others transport items without first confirming the nature of the goods.
Customs said it will continue to use risk management principles, focusing on passengers from high-risk areas for clearance checks, to ensure effective enforcement against cross-border drug trafficking.
Under Hong Kong's Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, trafficking in dangerous drugs is a serious offence. Upon conviction, the maximum penalty is a fine of HK$5 million and life imprisonment.
Members of the public can report suspected drug trafficking activities by calling the customs 24-hour hotline at 182 8080, by email at [email protected], or through the online form at eform.cefs.gov.hk/form/ced002.

content: Eric Chau   臉書  2026-11-8 香港禁片《消失的檔案》（Vanished Archives）是由香港資深傳媒人羅恩惠執導、歷時四年苦心搜集資料而完成的紀錄片。 這部影片之所以命名為「消失的檔案」，是因為導演當初在香港歷史檔案館搜集「六七暴動」的官方影像紀錄時，驚覺原應長達數百小時的歷史片段，在香港竟然只剩下殘缺不全的21秒。 為了尋回被刻意或無意抹去的歷史真相，羅恩惠遠赴英國國家檔案館翻查解密文件，並親自訪問了大量當年的親歷者。這部紀錄片最終揭露了多項關於1967年香港暴動事件、極具震撼力的內幕消息與歷史黑幕： 紀錄片揭露的四大核心內幕 1. 核心絕密文獻：《吳荻舟日記》與《67筆記》 影片最關鍵的歷史突破，是找到了當年國務院外事辦公室港澳組副組長吳荻舟的私人筆記與檢討材料。 中央高層直接介入： 過去有說法指六七暴動純屬香港左派造反派（如新華社香港分社）自導自演的盲動。但《67筆記》證實，北京中央政府對香港暴亂的每一個細節其實一直知情，甚至不時發出具體指示。 截獲「真槍實彈」： 筆記記載，當時有左派激進分子試圖從內地運送8,400把滅火刀（砍刀）到香港發動武裝暴動。這批物資最終被吳荻舟及時攔截，他因此在文革中遭到迫害。這證實當時暴動確實有演變成全面血腥武裝衝突的奪權計畫。 2. 揭開「少年犯」與「炸彈隊」的真實代價 六七暴動後期發展成無差別的恐怖主義炸彈襲擊，街道上到處都是俗稱「菠蘿」的土製炸彈。 被煽動的愛國學生： 影片訪問了多位當年的左派學校學生（如香島中學、培僑中學等）。他們在文革狂熱的政治宣傳下被煽動組織「炸彈隊」，抱著「反英抗暴」的愛國熱忱上街投擲炸彈、派發傳單。 被拋棄的犧牲品： 這些年輕人在入獄後遭到港英政府的嚴刑拷打，甚至被秘密政治部審訊。然而，當暴動被周恩來叫停、事件平息後，中共高層為了重回外交正軌，迅速與這些基層左派「割席」。這些留有案底的年輕人被港英政府與中共雙方拋棄，政治狂熱退去後，換來的是大半生的坎坷與幻滅。 3. 港共地下黨的權力鬥爭與盲動 紀錄片揭示，這場暴動本質上是中國文化大革命在香港的外延與投影。當時新華社香港分社（實際上的港共地下黨組織）社長梁威林、副社長祁烽等人，為迎合內地文革「造反有理」的風潮，並在外交部奪權鬥爭中表態，不惜在香港無限放大勞資糾紛（新蒲崗人造花廠事件），刻意將其升級為流血政治對抗。 4. 歷史敘事權的爭奪與「改寫」 這部影片最深遠的內幕，莫過於揭露了官方對歷史記憶的系統性清洗。 港英政府的處理： 六七暴動結束後，英國政府將大量極度敏感的政治部（Political Department）檔案、港共滲透名單及審訊紀錄運回英國本土，或直接銷毀，導致香港本地檔案館出現巨大斷層。 特區政府的洗白： 導演指出，近年來特區政府及建制陣營正試圖「重塑」這段歷史，淡化無差別炸彈襲擊對平民造成的傷害，將其重新包裝成「反殖民統治的愛國正義抗爭」。《消失的檔案》則透過血淋淋的受害者證詞（如商業電台林彬被活活燒死、北角小姊弟被炸彈炸死的家屬訪問），還原了這場運動曾演變成無差別恐怖襲擊的史實。 影片的遭遇與社會餘波 由於影片赤裸裸地曝光了中共與港共組織在歷史上的操弄與滲透，《消失的檔案》在2017年完成後遭遇了極大的政治壓力： 官方及商業電影院拒絕放映，香港國際電影節亦以「缺乏藝術性」為由將其拒之門外。 儘管遭受封殺，導演依然在香港社區、學校及海外（美、加、台）進行了數百場獨立放映，引發極大反響，被歷史學者視為還原香港當代史最重要的民間口述紀錄片。 歷史猶如一面鏡子，五十年前內地與香港的政治糾葛，與今日香港的政治變遷有著絲絲入扣的歷史脈絡。羅恩惠導演曾表示，拍攝這部影片不為挑起仇恨，而是為了「守護香港記憶，不讓真相在掌權者的橡皮擦下消失」。

title: 姜福祯：代序一 神州何处觅自由？——有感于李建强律师再度被扣押执业证

content: 前些日子，李建强告诉我，他的律师证年审没有通过，整个华冠律师事务所也受了株连。我的朋友中有不少律师，打听之下才知道，不光华冠，其他所也有集体未通过年审的，并非都出于政治原因。那时我还心存侥幸，希望李律师的执业空间能够延续下去。我深知，当下中国最缺的就是维权律师。 结果，他的执业证还是被扣押了。无论是讲政治的江泽民时代，还是讲和谐的胡锦涛时代，《维权律师，一个危险的职业》的作者都没能逃脱执业危机。 众所周知，律师不仅是法律工作者，更是自由职业者。控辩双方依据法条对决于法庭，在认知的碰撞中平衡法律、彰显公正。在法治完善的地方，律师在庭审中的认知和言论自由往往能发挥到极致；而在我国，由于司法局、政法委和“四项基本原则”的种种桎梏，律师的认知和言论自由十分有限，他们在法庭内外承受着来自各方的压力，乃至利诱、威胁和逮捕。这正是当代中国维权律师成为稀缺资源的根本原因。如今，著名维权律师李建强再度被扣押执业证，被迫“解甲”赋闲。试问，自由职业者的自由何在？ 一个雷雨将至的夜晚，我读到李建强的文章《为自由辩护》。他写道：“最近，因我而被株连两个多月的所里其他同事的律师证终于被注册了，而我的注册却遥遥无期。” 他又写道：“我说的是真话。因为我发现，我的自由民主的理念、人权法治的理念，跟执政党和政府认定的‘敌对势力’的理念是完全相同的。政府一定发现：鉴于我无法祛除深植于脑海里的‘敌对势力’的‘自由民主、人权法治’的理念，这个律师不能再继续执业。” 在这篇文章里，李建强回顾了给自己带来执业风险的辩护风格，归纳为三个特征：一是把自己与当事人混同的非职业化特征；二是拒绝党国价值标准的飞蛾扑火式特征；三是雁过留名式的激情辩护。 应该说，在尊重当事人和委托人选择的前提下，他确实常常如此：敢于执律师这一自由职业之剑，为自由声辩。这种风格在陈树庆案的辩护中表现得尤为成功。我仔细研读过他经手的几个案子，他嗅觉灵敏，周到细致，很下功夫，作为律师，在技术上无疑是尽了力的。由于他经手的案子大多处在时事焦点上，加之“著名政论写手刘路”与“著名律师李建强”两种角色相互错位，他的处事风格不能不格外惹人注目。说实话，对刘路先声夺人、主动出击、居高临下的道德评判，以及雁过留名、近乎急功近利的写作，我常常难以一以贯之地作出价值判断，也有许多不认同之处。李建强与刘路形影相随，风头强劲，十分抢眼，难免招致一些质疑和杯葛。 我与李建强律师相识，是因为任自元一案。当时我和陈青山、杨天水、车宏年等人急于为任自元找一位敢说话的维权律师，先后联系了几位，都未能如愿。李建强那时律师证第一次被扣押，自己也无法接案，但他仍热情地约见我们，帮我们仔细分析案情。他独特的视角和有些天马行空的说话方式，给我们留下了很深的印象。不久，他几经周折取回了律师证，接下一个又一个“言论自由案”，大刀阔斧，一路走来，先后为张林、师涛、杨天水、郭起真、张建红、严正学、陈树庆、池建伟等人辩护。这些案子的得失很难量化打分，但能有一位律师为异议人士声辩，而且多数是无罪辩护，没有胆识是做不到的。 在绝对权力的背景下，中国社会正在黑社会化，权贵资本的猖獗正在蚕食公正、良知、法律和个人权利，地方利益集团“水泼不进，针插不入”的局面已经形成。维权，已成为被压迫、被损害的草根群体最艰难的选择，中国迫切需要敢言敢为的维权律师。这应是建设和谐社会的前提，也是“执政为民”既说又做的最真实路径。可是，此时此地，维权律师群体和敢言的作家、记者却遭受一轮又一轮的打压。据悉，至今被拒绝注册执业证的维权律师还有河南的李苏滨，广东的郭艳、唐荆陵，广西的杨在新等；被关押的知名维权人士和法律工作者还有山东的陈光诚、广东的郭飞雄、浙江的陈树庆等人。 我想起一本胡适传记，书名就叫《无地自由》。自由主义的大师竟“无地自由”，这是怎样的悲哀！半个多世纪过去了，历史的车轮却在倒退，更可悲的是，连胡适式的自由在中共体制下也已荡然无存。刚刚听到一个“利好”消息：律师法修订草案有重要改进，律师将有条件地享有职业豁免权，主要内容是律师在法庭上的言论可以免受追究。言下之意，在中国是以言治罪的，律师之外的人言论出格，仍然严惩不贷。这种花瓶式的立法，本意是想显示开明，却一下子露出了长期因言治罪的“尾巴”。 神州何时觅自由？神州何处觅自由？ 自由啊，自由，从上个世纪之初到世纪之末，再到新的世纪，在中国大陆始终是一个难以企及的梦。自由的狙击手们，何时才会放下你们的武器？ （二〇〇七年八月九日于青岛咫尺居）

content: 昨天，中共及其玩弄于股掌之间的八个“民主”党派、亦即政治花瓶等约三千人，参加了孙中山先生诞辰160周年（1866.11.12）纪念大会。习近平以中共党主席军委主席国家主席三驾马车一人拉的显赫身份，强打精神，作了洋洋洒洒长约五千多字的讲话。这篇由秘书起草、AI润色、小学生照本宣科的讲话，首先虚情假意“高度评价”了孙中山伟大民族英雄、爱国主义者和中国民主革命先驱的历史地位，说什么国父提出三民主义、五权宪法、《建国方略》等理论构想，其思想至今影响深远…… 随即，习的讲话突然来了个然而大转弯，无中生有地强调“中国共产党人是孙中山革命事业最坚定的支持者、最忠诚的合作者和最忠实的继承者”。号召“海内外中华儿女继承和发扬孙中山先生的爱国、为民、求真、奋斗、团结及胸怀天下的宝贵精神，通过坚持中国式现代化，全面推进强国建设和民族复兴伟业”。最后不忘那句“坚定不移地推进祖国完全统一”——言外之意就是“解放台湾”。 这些套话废话，说到底还是要搞共产党的“一裆钻进”和习包子的个人“毒菜”。自我贴金的所谓纪念孙中山的讲话，是不学无术的习近平在借题发挥，誓把孙中山先生当成独裁政权的遮羞布，维稳之需的挡箭牌。习的狼子野心暴露无遗，令人心惊胆战毛骨悚然。 须知，打孙中山这张牌是中共政治需要。 说早点，1949年中共篡政后，为哄骗海内外财富巨头知识精英归来为恶党效力，将国父画像高悬天安门城楼，确实让不少人上当受骗回归祖国。而当他们真正归来后，方知中共的阶级斗争连绵不绝，政治运动方兴未艾。那些剃光头戴高帽、跪板凳挨批斗的日子，让著名作家老舍跳入太平湖，北平和平解放功臣傅作义的兄弟傅作恭，应召回国后竟被打成右派、活活饿死在夹边沟。步入虎穴、悔之晚矣！ 说晚点，1966年国父百年诞辰，本来应该大势庆祝一番，却因毛要打倒刘而将庆典一脚踹开。而当宋庆龄对文革提出异议时，毛泽东恼羞成怒，威胁要将国母“礼送出境”到台湾。要人就要人，不要人屙尿淋。 联想到上月底发布的五中全会公报，真的是睁起眼睛说瞎话，说的比唱的好听。 首先，参加五中全会的人员缺席近四分之一，五中全会就开成了五中不全会。这些年来的大清洗，整掉大批党内军内官员，他们本是习近平铁杆，有名有姓被开除党籍者达34人之多，调离冷藏多少则语焉不详。擅权、多疑、德不配位的习近平清除异己的斗争，看来遥遥无期啊！ 中共凭借枪杆子篡夺政权后，并未立地成佛，反而仰仗手中武器自诩领导工农商学兵，指挥东西南北中，号令五大洲四大洋……这位小学肄业差生假博士错别字连篇的习近平，是中共国77年来所有共酋中最缺乏知识的小学未毕业的红小兵出生，偏偏自不量力屡次三番地要给世界人民指明方向，所以他就必须清除比他稍微清醒一点的同僚——正如武大郎开店，高个子统统打来爬起！如此一来，方能显示席姓溲包子出类拔萃的“高明”。满纸荒唐、错漏百出的等身著作，总量超过了马恩列斯毛刘周朱。怪就怪在这堆口水话连篇的所谓“著作”，尔等还必须奉为精典，天天灌输，以巩固”两个确立定方向，两个维护见行动，四个意识、四个自信跟着走”，将神州搞成他的习家天下。 但这也不是一无是处，至少它能为大陆废纸回收行业提供源源不断的资源——中共独裁，君不见面向全球大撒币，雄安新区变鬼城，烂尾楼遍地，浪费点纸张算什么？继续出版无人问津的“习著”何乐而不为？ 一言以蔽之，日前纪念孙中山大会和上月召开的五中全会，都是在为二十一大作铺垫，今日司马昭之心众人皆知：习近平谋求连任。 但五中全会开成了五中不全会，说明习近平不得人心。妄想从纪念孙中山诞辰160周年大会借力，结果又是弄巧成拙：因为国父反的就是晚清那套家庭式的终身制，而习近平鼓吹的恰巧是复辟晚清那套政治体制。借力反弹，搬起石头砸了自己的脚。呜呼！看来习近平的连任美梦可能要泡汤哟！

title: Acer創辦人施振榮 獲指派任臺灣APEC峰會代表
